achievements: Refactored browsing skill to SOLID architecture (BrowserManager, InteractionService, VisualService, CommandRegistry, DiscoveryService, RefinementService).
Implemented 'click-at(x, y)' for absolute coordinate clicking.
Successfully mapped visual CAPTCHA grid cells to page coordinates.
Verified coordinate-based interaction: Cell (0,0) in Traffic Lights challenge was successfully selected and checkmarked.
limitations: Google reCAPTCHA v2 challenges often require multiple validation rounds and are highly sensitive to non-human signals (e.g., repeating the same viewport, IP reputation). Full bypass may require more complex session management.

solid_design_notes.SRP: Decoupled browser lifecycle from interaction and discovery logic.
solid_design_notes.OCP: Used CommandRegistry to allow new actions (like click-at) to be added without modifying index.ts.
solid_design_notes.DIP: Injected services into command contexts instead of using global state.
